text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reconfirming the data. 1800m Turf race. 
310m final stretch, with a steep 2.2m 
uphill slope right before the goal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Conditions I would have deemed a bit too 
harsh before my debut. However, now—
choice_data_list: You can push right through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Heading into the Satsuki Sho, I will run 
today's 1800m with everything I have."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, should we fail to achieve 
that today... it would be wise to 
reconsider our route."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath that calm suggestion, I could feel 
Mihono Bourbon's quiet resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stepping stone to the Satsuki Sho, the 
Spring Stakes is underway!
